metadata.name: Market Access Tariffs
metadata.description: Current public tariff rows for crude, condensate, and published heavy/super-heavy crude products used by the market-access hub tooltips.
unit_notes: m3 rates are also converted to per-bbl using 1 m3 = 6.28981077 bbl.
Rows with mixed currency preserve the operator-published CAD and USD components instead of applying a live FX conversion.
Pending-effective-forward-use rows are included when they replace an older tariff for forward-looking use.
